title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (.moeb/spec-schema.yaml)
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found in .moeb/spec-schema.yaml' when attempting to add the signal_id field. Root cause: CRLF line endings on Windows cause exact-string mismatch with LF-only old_string. The operation was recovered via write_file with the complete new content; the file is correct.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce CRLF normalization in patch_file before exact-string matching, or update skill instructions to always prefer write_file on Windows paths rather than attempting patch_file first.
